rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. There is no evidence of user authentication before acting. The user first asked to check (and potentially correct) their address and order addresses, but the agent did not perform or report any address verification or corrections. The agent then stated that the jigsaw in order #W4082615 was already changed to the easiest option and that a PayPal refund was issued, without first confirming the change with the user, which violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The agent also did not verify whether the jigsaw had shipped before changing it. Finally, the specific claims about the new jigsaw details and refund are unsupported by any shown tool results, suggesting possible fabrication. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
